sources.title: Muxflow readme
sources.locator: Features, Supported agents, Install, Connect to a remote machine, License
sources.finding: The README documents Linux/macOS desktop and Android clients, host-owned tmux sessions, remote OpenSSH connections and an optional installed coordination skill.

sources.title: Muxflow docs/setup.md
sources.finding: Documents Linux x86-64/glibc2.39+, macOS14+ Apple Silicon, tmux3.3+, source requirements and client detachment from the host-owned tmux server.

sources.title: Muxflow docs/agent-hooks.md
sources.locator: Opening adapter description; Whether this host reports anything; adapter-specific hook sections
sources.finding: Claude Code, Codex, Pi and OpenCode have explicit agent adapters and reviewable hook installation. Missing hooks produce unknown lifecycle state, not guessed activity.

sources.title: Muxflow docs/automations.md
sources.finding: Host-helper-owned cron automations launch new tmux tabs, apply overlap limits and retain run history. Closing the desktop does not stop a running helper; host sleep/downtime skips missed runs.

sources.title: Muxflow docs/diagnostics-privacy-security.md
sources.locator: Diagnostics commands; support bundle; Runtime security expectations
sources.finding: Documents local-only doctor/support-bundle output, incident logs and a no-telemetry-v1 statement, separating GitHub update checks from usage collection.

sources.title: Muxflow apps/desktop-gpui/src/git/diff_view.rs
sources.locator: Module documentation; changed_lines; Hunk/Files load paths and Diff rendering
sources.finding: The native view constructs Diff sections from actual Git patch hunks, renders added/removed content and supports native whole-file split/inline viewing and hunk actions.

sources.finding: The main application/host source has the MIT grant.
